evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Framing a test case as reproducing another's failure pattern enacts even-exchange: this output mirrors that input, one-for-one correspondence.

observations.why: Deontic 'must' issues a constraint the system is expected to obey — hierarchy enacted as command, not negotiation.
